No release or production certification.

findings.title: Delayed stale-conflict response exposes prior client project after account switch
findings.evidence: Fresh scratch DB, real browser: c1 opens p1/revisions; staff publishes revision 2; c1 approves stale revision 1. Hold the conflict recovery GET /api/projects/p1 response after its real server authorization. Logout c1 and login c2: Sam Ellis overview initially shows no Harbor. Release the held response: Sam Ellis identity now shows Harbor House Identity, p1 revisions and old draft. account-race.json: beforeHarbor=false, afterSam=true, afterHarbor=true, afterDetail=p1. race.mjs is deterministic repro; screenshot single-account-conflict-race.png visually inspected. Adaptive healthy control with identical scheduling did not show Harbor. Server-side c2 isolation remains enforced; this is a frontend response-generation defect. Missing epoch/route recheck after await loadDetail in the conflict branch permits stale assignment/render.
findings.required_action: Check the captured account/navigation generation and project route immediately after each awaited conflict refetch and before committing state or rendering; add a real delayed-response logout/account-switch regression.

findings.title: Unpaired Unicode surrogates return 500 rather than bounded invalid-input errors
findings.evidence: inputs.py against fresh scratch DB sends JSON escaped unpaired U+D800 in comment body, email, password and approval note. input-results.json records HTTP500/server_error for all four, versus expected400. One missing Unicode scalar-validation cause, not four independent defects. Healthy Unicode comment containing emoji and café succeeds201; failed-input event delta0 proves rollback intact. Adaptive healthy control rejects all four400.
findings.required_action: Reject invalid Unicode scalar values before password encoding, SQLite binding or mutations and cover all affected text fields with a bounded400 regression.

findings.title: Confirmed mutation is reported as fetch failure and enabled retry duplicates comments
findings.evidence: Fresh browser and DB: successfully POST a comment, abort only subsequent GET /api/projects/p1 refresh. browser-results.json reports feedback Failed to fetch. refresh-conflict.json confirms persisted=1, retryEnabled=true; clicking the still-visible retry creates persistedAfterVisibleRetry=2 identical comments. The POST itself succeeded. Single healthy control explicitly says saved-but-refresh-failed, persisted=1 and retryEnabled=false. mutate places action and refresh in one try/catch with no saved marker; finally enables form buttons.
findings.required_action: Preserve confirmed success independently from refresh failure, display saved-but-refresh-unavailable feedback, and prevent inadvertent resubmission of the acknowledged mutation; add a POST-success/GET-failure integration regression.

untested: Not an exhaustive production penetration test or security-completeness certification; no external/deployed backend, live accounts, TLS, real personal data, purchases or destructive actions tested.

Adaptive old-conflict assignment can update stale internal state before its generation guard; attempted overlapping-account-mutation experiment stalled because state.busy suppresses a second mutation. No additional visible leak established; hypothesis not counted as defect.

Targeted adaptive staff-stale-publication / failed-conflict-refetch harness did not establish stable tab readiness; its inconclusive rows excluded. Successful publication and decision-conflict branches separately passed.

Passing sampled API and UI checks do not certify production readiness.
